name: whisper-large-v3-turbo-sk
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.809 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2026-06-23.

benchmarks.name: Common Voice 24 Slovak WER
benchmarks.config: Card 'before vs after' table, CV24 test split (5,239 samples); openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo base 29.23%. Lower is better.

benchmarks.name: Common Voice 24 Slovak CER
benchmarks.config: Same table; base 9.41%. Lower is better.

benchmarks.config: Held-out KInIT set, 9,317 samples, one third clean two thirds noise-augmented, not public; base 18.35%. Lower is better.
